spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Containers with borders MUST have padding to avoid collision.

grid_modes.marketing: Grid cols 1 md:cols-8 lg:cols-12 gap-8 to gap-12 with asymmetric spanning (Tetris Grid).
grid_modes.dashboard: Grid cols 1 md:cols-3 lg:cols-4 gap-4 to gap-6. Every pixel utilized, h-full on children (Control Room Grid). Applies to Fixtures, Leaderboards, and Profile.

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-align dense data. Center hero text only if it improves visual rhythm.
spacing_and_layout.hero_overlay: bg-black/50 to bg-black/70. For images where details matter, use gradient overlays: bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0A0A] via-[#0A0A0A]/60 to-transparent.

surface_styles.cards: Flat background (#141414), 1px solid border (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)), no shadow. Avoid excessive rounded corners (max rounded-md).
surface_styles.header: Crystal Glass variant: bg-[#0A0A0A]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10. Must be sticky with z-50.
surface_styles.buttons: Primary: bg-[#007AFF] text-white hover:bg-[#3395FF] border border-transparent. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 hover:border-white text-white. Use clear data-testid attributes.
surface_styles.inputs: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/20 text-white focus:border-[#007AFF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#007AFF]. No rounded-full inputs, stick to sharp or slightly rounded corners.
surface_styles.tables: Accessible data tables. border-collapse. Items have border-b border-white/10. Highlight row on hover with bg-[#1C1C1C].

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactives must explicitly set hover colors. E.g., hover:text-white, hover:bg-[#1C1C1C].
motion_and_interactions.focus_states: High contrast focus rings. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#007AFF] focus:outline-none.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for buttons, cards, inputs.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENTATION CRITICAL: You must write React functional components (.js/.jsx) with Tailwind CSS classes as defined here.
HERO SECTION: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for creative overlapping. Display 'World Cup Predictor 2026', tournament countdown, and large CTA. Use 'dark stadium background' image provided.
FIXTURES/MATCHES: Dashboard 'Control Room' grid. Cards with team flags, scores, date/time, and a 'Predict' CTA button. Add filtering by group/stage/date.
PREDICTION FORM: Must include input fields for Team A score, Team B score, Winner selection, and MOTM (Man of the Match) as TEXT INPUT.

VIEW SQUAD LINK: On matches and awards prediction pages, display a highly visible hyperlink 'View Squad' pointing to https://fdp.fifa.org/assetspublic/ce281/pdf/SquadLists-English.pdf. Style it as an overline or text-sm primary link with an external link icon.
AWARDS PREDICTION: 4 categories (Golden Boot, Golden Glove, Player of the Tournament, Fair Play). MUST use text input (not dropdown) for player/team names.
LEADERBOARD: Table component with filters (global/country/weekly). Show rank, avatar/flag, points, accuracy%.
TEAMS & STADIUMS: Image grids. Teams (48 teams) with flag cards. Stadiums (16 venues) with stadium image, capacity, matches hosted.
PROFILE & ADMIN: Standard Shadcn customized dashboard layout. Sidebar navigation.
AUTH: Email/password authentication via Shadcn Form. Include country flag selection during registration.
TESTING: Add data-testid attributes to ALL buttons, inputs, links, and forms (e.g., data-testid='predict-match-button', data-testid='motm-input').
SHADCN UI: Do not use native HTML elements for forms/dropdowns. Use customized Shadcn elements with dark mode palette.
NO MOCK DATA PLACEHOLDERS IN UI: Even if mock data is used for rendering, it should look authentic and not say 'Mock' or 'Test'.
